# PR-scoped removals for in-scope entities

When a PR deletes an in-scope file, the corresponding in-scope entities (e.g. test-coverage entries) are removed from storage, while out-of-scope components survive. This enforces scope-limited deletion semantics.

**Anchored to:**

- `tests/test_incremental.py` — `tests.test_incremental.test_pr_deletion_removes_only_in_scope_entities`
